secondToolValidation.tool: Claude Code, desktop application, fresh session
secondToolValidation.justification: Fresh-session independent audit of the sealed GATE-3-CP-0001 and the M1 Gates. One HIGH finding: the published history cannot validate GATE-1-CP-0001, so a clean clone of the remote fails the mandatory tests gate (M1-F-003). The tool, provider and model are the implementing runs', so this is session independence and not cross-tool validation, and it is not recorded as one.

deliveryCompleteness.auditor: Delivery Completeness Validator, M1 fresh-session audit pass

independentReview.tool: Claude Code, fresh session, Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5
independentReview.justification: M1-F-003 (HIGH): GATE-1-CP-0001's sealed ledger names a commit no published reference reaches, so the checkpoint does not validate from the published history and every clean clone of the remote fails the mandatory tests gate; four of twenty frozen criteria fail on it. M1-F-001 and M1-F-002 (MEDIUM) go with it. The isolation, the cross-gate flow, R-G3-001 and the full verification of this repository all hold.

redTeam.tool: the cross-gate adversarial battery of this audit, independent of the Gates' batteries
redTeam.justification: Fourteen attacks — nine on real sandboxes on the real engine, five on the stack and disposable clones — over a null-mutation control that was accepted first. None escaped.
